system.summary: Simple substitution of letters by signs (digits, letters, a cross, a triangle and a few special shapes), with two signs for i (g/9 and y) and five code groups followed by a point: 18 Duca di Lorena, 34 S.A., 37 Re, 57 S.M.tà Catt., iio V.E. Word gaps mostly real.
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts the 26 tokens of key.tsv (21 letter signs and 5 code groups). Letters not seen: k, x, j. Vlnas 2017 (ch. 4.3, table 5) printed the same system from inv. 24790.

prior_solution.where: The contemporary interlinear decipherments of the sibling letters inv. 24784, 24786, 24796 (and others not used) on the same microfilm, and Vlnas 2017 (BA thesis, Univerzita Hradec Králové, theses.cz/id/p3p2kb), ch. 4.3, table 5 and his decipherment of inv. 24790. Vlnas lists 24793 and 24800 in his appendix B as not deciphered and gives no text for them. A web search and the catalogue checks found no edition or decipherment of these two letters (6 Nov 2026).

solution.what: Appendix zip of Vlnas 2017 (theses.cz/id/p3p2kb): photographs of the microfilm frames of inv. 24784-24806, and the thesis text.
Vlnas 2017 (appendix B lists 24793 and 24800 as not deciphered), one web search, the catalogue's earlier checks: no edition or decipherment of 24793 or 24800 found.

Key built from the glossed words of 24784 and the glossed code groups of 24796, compared with Vlnas's table 5 and his 24790 decipherment (h taken from Vlnas; later found glossed on 24784 too), and frozen in key_frozen.tsv before the held-out frame was opened.

Frozen key applied to three partial cipher lines of the held-out glossed frame 24786: 13 of 13 words agree with the gloss in sense, 10 letter for letter (communica, doppo and col are spelling variants); no sign failed. Small, the gloss was visible on the crops, and the freeze rests on file times only.
24793 and 24800 transcribed twice from separate crops and reconciled on the image; not blind to the sense.
Both letters decrypted with the frozen key and read with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py fails on any unmarked departure.

Independent check (VERIFY.md): blind transcription of 13 lines of the bare frames and 3 held-out passages (443 signs) before opening the solver's files; after settling, 3 places differ (0.7%): one shape-only slip, one dropped sign in the held-out copy, one unresolved z shape. Key spot-checked on 24784 and against Vlnas's table; tamper tests of the mark check. Six fixes asked for.

Fixes made: held-out 'doppo' corrected (10 of 13 letter for letter, not 11); the 'forze' sign marked doubtful; pairs.tsv and scripts/check_pairs.py added (42 glossed words, all 21 letter signs and 5 code groups, all decrypt to the gloss); margins stated. 24793 falls to 79 of 83 verbatim (95.2%), 75 of 79 without code groups (94.9%), and is marked read in part, not read.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key built from the contemporary interlinear decipherment of the sibling letters 24784 and 24796 (same writer, same year, same microfilm) and compared with Vlnas 2017's printed table; frozen and tested on the held-out glossed sibling 24786; then applied unchanged to the bare letters 24793 and 24800.
outcome.fraction_read_source: scripts/check_marks.py: 107 of 116 cipher words verbatim from the signs in 24793 (79 of 83) and 24800 (28 of 33); the code groups are counted as words.

texts.label: inv. 24793, Innsbruck 1646
texts.summary: Success in Flanders depends on acting in concert and quickly while the Catholic and enemy forces are even; the opportunity should be used also on the side of the Duke of Lorraine, unless he has hidden aims ruled by his passions or inconstancy; the King did well to keep Piccolomini in Flanders this year too, since the French will press their enterprises; may God give him complete victory. Written in the 1646 campaign, when Piccolomini commanded for Philip IV in the Spanish Netherlands.
texts.note: Words 83: 79 verbatim from the signs (95.2%), 1 with a doubtful sign shape ('forze'), 3 with a marked one-sign repair, no guesses, no holes. Without the 4 code groups 75 of 79 (94.9%), under the 95% bar, so marked read in part.

reading_review.by: AI language-model agent (for WAINUT; a model reading, not a person), recorded at packaging from the independent check in VERIFY.md
reading_review.note: The independent check confirmed the key, the sign copy and every marked repair it could see on the image, but gave no letter grade; grade B (coherent, normalised in the reading) was recorded when the folder was packaged. Coherent throughout; weak places are the doubtful z of 'forze' (L03) and the three one-sign repairs (L02 con, L04 de', L08 dall').

texts.label: inv. 24800, Innsbruck, 25 September 1646
texts.summary: The news from Flanders is not very good for the interests of the King; affairs there go badly, in great part through the disorders of the Duke of Lorraine's [?undisciplined troops], which, as Piccolomini wrote, could bring still greater ruin. Written a few weeks before Dunkirk fell to Enghien in October 1646.
texts.note: Words 33: 28 verbatim from the signs (84.8%), 5 with marked repairs, of which 'indisciplinate genti' (2 words, two changed signs) is a conjecture flagged [?...]. Without the 2 code groups 26 of 31 (83.9%).

gaps.item: 24793 L03 'forze': the fourth sign is not the key's z shape
gaps.detail: Only z gives a word; counted as doubtful. A clean scan from SOA Zámrsk would settle it, and with it the 'read' status of 24793.
The signs give 'indisciplinitelenti'; two changed signs give the reading. Needs a clean image of L05.

gaps.item: Five single-sign repairs (5/s and g/D shapes, a cross for 4, a 2/Q loop)
gaps.detail: The photographs are soft; clean scans of inv. 24793 and 24800 would have to be ordered from SOA Zámrsk.
Three partial lines, 13 words, with the gloss visible on the crops; the freeze rests on file times. The unused glossed frames 24787, 24788, 24789, 24794, 24799 and 24806 would give a larger test.
Day and month are not on the frame; the letter may continue on a page not in the zip.
